newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ishihara sees bigger 1996/97 net loss. [CORRECTED 09:47 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Ishihara sees bigger 1996/97 net loss. [CORRECTED 09:47 GMT]

text.p: Ishihara Sangyo Kaisha Ltd said on Friday it expected its parent net loss would be 4.30 billion yen (Corrects from 4.80 billion yen) in the business year to March 1997, higher than its prior forecast issued last November of a 3.80 billion yen loss.

"Our parent net loss in 1996/97 will rise by 500 million yen because of an appraisal loss for shares in a wholly owned Australian investment company, ISK Australia," a spokesman for the titanium oxide producer said.
